metadata.technology_specification: Benchtop flow cytometer with multi-laser optical detection system
metadata.technology_reasoning: The most common industrial and research flow cytometers in 2024 are benchtop models featuring multiple lasers for excitation and optical detection of multiple fluorescence channels, which dominate due to their versatility and throughput in biomedical applications.

components.reasoning: Core for transporting and hydrodynamically focusing cell samples through the detection region; universally separate subsystem.
Multi-laser arrays for fluorescent dye excitation are essential, separate units procured with dedicated power supplies and optics.
Includes photomultiplier tubes (PMTs) or photodiodes and optical filters to detect emitted fluorescence, standard and separate assembly.
Main PCB controlling data acquisition, signal processing, and hardware interfacing; standard and distinct component.
Allows manual or automated sample introduction; common modular assembly usually procured separately.
Computer or embedded system running software for data analysis, standard in modern flow cytometers.
Provide and control sheath fluid flow critical for focusing cells; distinct modules in fluidics subsystem.
Collects used fluid samples; modular and separate part of the fluidics design.
Protective housing and structural frame; separate assembly varied by manufacturer but always present.
